purpose: Corrections to OCR damage that was certified into the Phase 2 canonical talent text. Corrections are made in the Phase 2 content authority (data/audits/talent-phase-2-*-content.json) and flow through tools/build-talent-canonical-authority.mjs and tools/build-talent-phase-3b-manifest.mjs; no Phase 3B manifest is edited by hand.

method.rule: A correction is TXT_CONFIRMED only when the individual sourcebook TXT itself supplies the evidence (a paired delimiter, a clean sibling occurrence, or the TXT rules text visibly ending before appended page furniture). Where the TXT is damaged the entry is TXT_AMBIGUOUS_PDF_REQUIRED. No bulk punctuation or spelling clean-up was performed; every edit is an exact substring replacement recorded below.

statusVocabulary.TXT_CONFIRMED: evidence is in the individual sourcebook TXT
statusVocabulary.TXT_AMBIGUOUS_PDF_REQUIRED: TXT damaged or ambiguous; PDF check required before certification
statusVocabulary.PRIOR_PDF_AUDIT_RECORDED: a rendered-PDF verification is recorded in repository audit documents but was not repeated by this audit

method.detection: signature scan (html tags, backslash, pipe, tilde, curly braces, gibberish tokens) over every certified target text field plus a full scan of all 1180 canonical records for the same signatures, all-caps caption/heading words and unbalanced brackets
method.limits: signature-based; OCR damage without a detectable signature (a silently wrong letter, a dropped word) cannot be found by scanning and needs a PDF proofread

fields.currentValue:
This talent allows you to redirect a deflected blaster bolt along a specific trajectory so that it damages another creature or object in its path, Once per round when you successfully deflect a blaster bolt, you can make an immediate ranged attack against another target with which you have line of sight. Apply the normal range penalties to the attack roll (see Table 8-5: Range Penalties}, not counting the distance the bolt traveled to reach you. If the attack succeeds, it deals norma! weapon damage to the target.

Only single blaster bolts can be redirected in this manner. Barrages from autofire weapons and other types of projectiles can't be redirected.

You continue to occupy a space in this form, but other creatures can occupy the same space or move through your space without impediment. As a standard action, you can attempt to possess an adjacent target. You must succeed on a Use the Force check against an adjacent target's Will Defense. If your check result equals or exceeds the target's Will Defense, you deal 8d6 points of stun damage to the target; if you reduce the target to 0 hit points or move it to the bottom of the condition track with this attack, you possess the target as though it were a willing host (see the dark spirit template for details). Alternately, as a standard action, you can transfer your essence into a single adjacent object, such as a holocron or a lightsaber. SlveL sever)

though you had activated the power). If your check result equals or exceeds the Will Defense of the target of that missed attack, the attacker can reroll the missed attack roll.
